title: No Orphan Approvals
control_description: Every exception must have a named owner written justification expiry and second review above threshold
notes: Start with refunds access changes and vendor exceptions

title: Two-Person Rule for Irreversible Actions
control_description: Require independent second approval for irreversible actions above defined thresholds
notes: Thresholds must be documented and reviewed

title: Independent QA Sampling
control_description: Sample independently and randomly with documented methodology and visible findings

title: Independent Predicate Review
control_description: Require a materially independent reviewer to validate the factual predicate and alternatives before consequential action
notes: Derived from BI-PAT-001; reviewer must be outside the evidence-generating chain

title: Purpose-Bound Data Use
signal_trigger: Data requested for materially different use
control_description: Attach permitted-purpose metadata and require separate approval before secondary adverse use
notes: Truth of information does not authorize every use

title: Action-State Separation
control_description: Track proposed approved rejected attempted executed canceled and outcome as distinct immutable states
notes: Prevents later conflation of planning with execution

title: Full-Chain Auditability
control_description: Authorized reviewers must reconstruct source transformation attribution approvals downstream actions and disposition
notes: Derived from BI-PAT-003 while preserving legitimate compartmentation

title: No-Action Valid Outcome
signal_trigger: Teams measured on actions or tangible results
control_description: Explicitly permit and measure justified no-action outcomes without performance penalty
notes: Reduces pressure to manufacture interventions where evidence is weak
